what: Cut-out pieces in the hero fly in from their own off-screen spots (horizontal vw·vertical vh·tilt) over 1.5s in five jerky steps (steps(5)) with no in-between values, settling at .1s intervals. 1s after all have gathered, the title appears over 1s power2.out and bounces 1→1.15→.95→1.05→1 (.8s), then .5s later a band of large letters enters from 20% right in 1s and the handwritten decorations switch on together

options.dur: Time in seconds for one piece to fly in, default 1.5
options.each: Gap between pieces (s), default .1 — 0 means all at once
options.gap: Pause from when all pieces gather until the title (sec), default 1
options.band-delay: Pause until the band behind the title (s), default .5
options.title-ease: Easing for headings, bands and decorative curves, default power2.out
options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Incoming pieces (multiple). data-from="x y rotation" — x is in vw, y is in vh (if a unit is given it is used as is), rotation in degrees. If omitted, odd items start 50vh above and even items 100vh below
options.[data-fx-part=band]: Large text band entering from the right 20% (optional) — for the flow, attach the marquee part too
options.[data-fx-part=after]: Decorations that switch on with the band (optional, multiple)
